Petty Officer '''Colton''' served onboard the [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] ''[[FarStar]]'' during the hunt for [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]]. He was one of the few regular [[New Republic Defense Fleet/Legends|navy]] men assigned to the ship, and was often on duty in the ship's cee-cee. After the crew discovered that the ''FarStar'' was rigged with computer backdoors, he reported the findings of a sweep of the corvette's systems to [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Kaiya Adrimetrum]]. During the mission, Colton was promoted to the rank of [[Ensign/Legends|ensign]].

During the events surrounding the ''FarStar''{{'s}} skirmish with the [[Qektoth Confederation]], and the crew's exposure to a [[Qektoth Confederation biochemical agent|biochemical agent]], Colton was involved in an altercation with the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]], [[Krudar]].

==Biography==
Colton was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served in the [[New Republic Defense Fleet/Legends|New Republic Defense Fleet]] in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], and was assigned to the [[New Republic task force (Kal'Shebbol)|task force]]<ref name="Crisis" /> that successfully [[Battle of Kal'Shebbol|liberated]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kal'Shebbol/Legends|Kal'Shebbol]] from the [[Moff Sarne's forces|forces]] of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]]. During the battle, the Moff fled Kal'Shebbol with the majority of his forces, and headed into the wilds of the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]]. The [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] authorized a [[DarkStryder Campaign|mission]] to track down Sarne and neutralize the threat he posed to the region. A modified [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]], the ''[[FarStar]]'', was assigned to the mission,<ref name="TDC">''[[The DarkStryder Campaign]]''</ref> and Colton&mdash;who held the rank of [[Petty Officer/Legends|petty officer]]&mdash;was transferred aboard.<ref name="Crisis" /> Due to a manpower shortage, Colton was one of the few regular [[Navy/Legends|naval]] personnel assigned to the [[Starship/Legends|ship]], and many of the crew were civilians from Kal'Shebbol who had been recruited from the general population.<ref name="TDC" />

Several [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] into the mission, Colton presented a report to the [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the ''FarStar'', [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Kaiya Adrimetrum]].<ref name="Crisis" /> Shortly before, the crew of the ''FarStar'' had discovered that the vessel<ref name="Shintel">{{DarkStryder|adventure=Shintel Downtime|book=The DarkStryder Campaign}}</ref>&mdash;which had previously been part of Moff Sarne's forces and had subsequently been captured during the New Republic's victory at Kal'Shebbol<ref name="TDC" />&mdash;was rigged with boobytraps installed on Sarne's orders. After one of Sarne's [[Palme|agents]] successfully managed to trigger one trap that destroyed the [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] [[Engine/Legends|engines]], the ''FarStar'' was forced to limp to the [[Tanquilla Beach/Legends|''Tanquilla Beach'']] [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]] for repairs. During the refit, the cause of the sabotage was revealed, and [[Spang]], a local [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]], suggested that the ''FarStar'' visit the planet [[Pembric II]] and talk to a man named [[Breslin Drake]] who might have been able to direct the ''FarStar'' crew to an individual who could remove the programming trapdoors without triggering them.<ref name="Shintel" /> During the voyage to Pembric II, the crew of the ''FarStar'' swept the ship five times, and located three additional boobytraps, two in the life support circuitry, and one in the communications. Colton relayed the recommendations of the ''FarStar''{{'s}} [[chief engineer]], [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Lofryyhn]], to Captain Adrimetrum; namely, that no attempt should be made to remove the traps without understanding the nature, and that the ''FarStar'' lay over until all ship's systems were checked. Adrimetrum ordered Colton to inform Lofryyhn that the situation would be handled soon.<ref name="Crisis" />
